approvalScope: The four changed mechanisms and the sealed six-pair synthetic-local readiness runner. This is not a claim of full repository regression success, formal main acceptance, or deployed-product acceptance.
reviewMethod: Independent subagent read all current production diffs and added files, relevant lifecycle/authorization/verification callers, R5 execution and result scripts, then repaired confirmed issues and ran offline tests. No real model or external network calls.

findings.problem: Implicit unknown grammar could absorb an affirmative second clause separated by ASCII punctuation or Unicode line boundaries.
findings.fix: Constrain all implicit clause bodies to the same Chinese/ASCII punctuation and line-boundary contract; exact actual-visible binding and independent semantic support remain required.

findings.problem: Freeze checked only an approval boolean, so reviewed code or harness changes could be frozen without proving they were the approved bytes.
findings.fix: Review captures all desktop/resources/package bytes and R5 CJS/protocol bytes; prepare verifies exact file sets and hashes before copying. The evaluation seal also binds review and post-run scripts.

findings.problem: Copied result tooling used an R4-specific expired-memory ID and could attribute later phase, planner, metadata repair or instruction text to a worker evidence exposure; audit packet omitted actual delivery title and handoff.
findings.fix: Detect expired-memory fixtures from the fresh suite, select the same phase worker excluding planner/metadata repair, require source-bound body text for quote exposure, and export actual delivery title/handoff plus all execution inputs for independent audit.

findings.problem: Unknown usage totals and absent paired arms could be summarized as zero through empty reductions or null arithmetic.
findings.fix: Report exact totals and differences as null when usage is unknown or a paired branch is absent; retain explicitly named known-token subtotals and failed usage gate. Unknown usage makes token-limit confirmation undefined.

findings.problem: A missing-file negative observation still narrated that the original file was successfully opened and fully compared.
findings.fix: Observation note now distinguishes existing files that were fully compared from files explicitly observed missing; status/hash/comparison remain actual observations.

postRunLimitation: The pre-run review missed the no-handoff delegation completion path and a read-only fixture/output delivery conflict. See root-cause-audit.json. Pre-run approval does not establish runtime acceptance.
